subject: Telemetry launch: dashboard shaping, trace tags, and incident triage plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Sam Walters <sam.walters@clearpathlogistics.com>, Priya Anand <priya.anand@clearpathlogistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Telemetry launch: dashboard shaping, trace tags, and incident triage plan

Hi Sam + Priya,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — excited to get ClearPath telemetry into production next month. This thread is to align on three concrete blocks we discussed so the implementation team can start pairing with your SREs next week:

1) Dashboard shaping: a single overview dashboard (latency P95, error rate, avg tokens/use, model variant), plus two drilldowns (request-level traces; batching/throughput). We attached a checklist to iterate on widget priorities.

2) Trace and span tagging: we agreed on adding request_id, customer_id, model_name, model_variant, route, and sampled_reason tags. Need confirmation on current trace sampling policy on your side (Priya — are you on 10% or 100% for staging?).

3) Incident triage / alert routing: propose three alert tiers — page (end-to-end P95 > SLA threshold), ops-warning (error rate spike > 0.5% absolute), and advisory (backlog/queue growth). We'll draft runbook steps and ownership for each.

Next steps I propose:
- Your SREs share a short doc about sampling and any agent limitations by Fri 6/25.
- Marissa and Ben will run a 60-minute pairing session with your infra team the week of 6/28 to wire tracing hooks and surface initial dashboards.
- After pairing, we deliver a draft runbook and rule set for your review by 7/2.

Attachments: clearpath-telemetry-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with dashboard/widget suggestions)

If that timeline works I’ll send calendar invites.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference platform.
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@clearpathlogistics.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Telemetry launch: dashboard shaping, trace tags, and incident triage plan

Jonas — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers:

- Sampling: staging is 100%, prod is 10% right now (we can bump to 20% for a 48hr window during rollout).
- Ownership: infra (me + Priya) for agent config; platform team for dashboards once RDW ops hands off.
- Pairing: 6/29 works better for us (morning). Can Marissa do 9:00 AM PT?

Two asks from our side before pairing:
- Can you add model_variant to the checklist rows for quantized/onnx variants? We run multiple quantization profiles and need them surfaced.
- Please include an example of alert escalation paths that map to our PagerDuty routing keys.

On escalation paths, a quick note: our current PD policy separates customer-impacting pages from internal infra pages; we prefer Redwood's page-level alerts only when end-to-end latency or generation failures exceed the SLA.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Walters
Head of Infra, ClearPath Logistics
sam.walters@clearpathlogistics.com

Ben / Jonas — tagging in prep for the 6/29 session:

- I updated the checklist to add a model_variant column and example values (fp16, int8-quant, onnx-q4).
- Ben: can you prepare the trace hook snippets for our Python + Go agents? Small request: include the exact env var names we expect on ClearPath side so they can drop them into their helm charts.
- Jonas: I’ll run the 9:00 AM PT pairing and focus the first 20 minutes on sampling and agent configuration, then move into trace/span naming and dashboard wireframe decisions.

I added redwood-runbook-template.md to the Drive link; it includes suggested alert playbooks for the three tiers Jonas suggested. I’ll walk through the page-level playbook live so we can map PagerDuty keys to the right escalation.

--
Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Sam / Priya — thanks for the quick replies and clarity on sampling. Confirming outcomes from the pairing earlier today and next steps: 

- Pairing summary: agent hooks wired (Python/Go); request_id, customer_id, model_name, model_variant, route, sampled_reason are all being emitted to traces. Staging sampling 100% confirmed.
- Dashboards: first pass overview and two drilldowns are created in our sandbox; I shared editor access to your platform lead.
- Runbooks & alert routing: I updated the runbook template with PagerDuty mapping examples that follow your page/internal split. We left page-level escalation to your PD key 'clearpath-prod-pages'.

Deliverables and dates:
- Updated checklist and runbook posted (Drive) — done.
- Rule JSON for alerting (prometheus-alerts style) — posted by EOD 7/1.
- Follow-up QA window: 7/6 — 7/8 (run simulated traffic and verify sampling + dashboards).

If that timeline looks right I’ll close this thread and open a tracking ticket in HubSpot for the post-roll QA. Thanks everyone for fast turnaround.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
